name: Agent meters
description: How much of its context a coding agent has used and how long its prompt cache lasts, on its terminal: while it's idle its icon keeps its colour only as far as the cache has time left, draining from the top, and a ring beside its name in the Terminals panel fills up with its context. Read from its own transcripts on the server's machine (Claude Code's); the window is what Claude Code's status line said, when it writes one, else 200k tokens.

cache.label: Prompt cache
cache.description: the time its cache has left while idle: the icon draining from the top, or a ring inside the context's

context.label: Context
context.description: how full its context window is, beside its name
